verdict.rationale: Twilio SendGrid is an email delivery API and SMTP service, not an AI agent or tool-using host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
